data.name: Eve
data.gender_notes: Eve is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥawwah, associated with ḥayah, 'to live' (Genesis 3:20). Its root is Hebrew ḥ-w-h. Eve, the first woman (Genesis 3:20). Eve is a Hebrew name meaning “Life; living”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Eve expresses “Life; living”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Ḥawwah, associated with ḥayah, 'to live' (Genesis 3:20).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eve total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
